$comment: Canonical proof points for Claims 24/7, from design/claims247-proof-points.pdf (Perry, 9 September 2026), the source of truth for benefit wording on this site. Every grid, strip and keeps set renders from here; no benefit copy sits inline in a component. Short forms carry no "eligible": eligibility lives in the eligibility line and the terms. A point with a claim renders only while sites/mcd2/claims.json substantiates it. Three lines from the document break the copy lint (the exclamation and the two throwaway sentences in the settlement and recovery rows) and are not used anywhere.

points.title:
No excess
to pay
points.sub: We pursue the at-fault insurer, not your policy
points.long: On a non-fault claim we take on, we pursue the at-fault insurer, not your own policy, so you do not pay your policy excess.

points.title:
Like-for-like car,
van or motorbike
points.long: Get a replacement suited to your everyday needs, even if your own insurance does not include replacement vehicle cover.

points.short: We deal with the at-fault insurer
points.title:
We deal with the
at-fault insurer
points.sub: You don’t have to chase them
points.long: You don’t have to chase the other driver’s insurer. Our team has decades of claims experience and works directly with insurers. We manage the claim and the conversations on your behalf, keeping you informed as it progresses.

points.title:
Recovery, replacement
and repairs sorted
points.long: From recovering your damaged vehicle to arranging a like-for-like replacement vehicle and managing repairs, we coordinate the moving parts so you do not have to organise each service yourself.

points.short: Onward travel for you and your passengers
points.long: We can arrange onward travel for you and your passengers to an agreed destination, including a replacement vehicle or taxi where available and appropriate.

points.short: Updates your way: WhatsApp, email or phone
points.long: Choose how we keep in touch. Whether you prefer a WhatsApp message, an email you can read later or a phone conversation, we use the channel that works for you.
On a non-fault claim we take on, you do not need to pay for recovery, replacement vehicle hire or repairs upfront. We explain the arrangements, your responsibilities and how we work before you agree.
Stranded after an accident? We aim to have recovery with you within 90 minutes. We confirm an estimated arrival time based on your location and availability.

points.short: On average we answer the phone within 1 minute
points.long: Call and speak to a member of our team without waiting in a queue during our opening hours.
Repair work we arrange comes with a lifetime guarantee, with the cover and conditions explained before work begins.

points.short: New parts. Repairs to BS 10125 standards.
points.long: We arrange repairs using new parts through repairers working to BS 10125, so the quality of the repair matters as much as getting you moving again.

points.short: We don’t take a cut of your vehicle settlement
points.long: We do not deduct a percentage fee from your vehicle damage settlement.
Have a main point of contact who knows your claim, answers your questions and coordinates the next steps, supported by our UK claims team.
If your vehicle is written off and the insurer’s offer does not reflect its value, we challenge it using evidence about its specification, condition and comparable vehicles.

points.short: We fight your corner when fault is disputed
points.long: If the other insurer disputes who caused the accident, we bring together the available evidence, such as photographs, dashcam footage and witness accounts, and challenge their position where justified.
